title: Eastern-Style Bamboo Shoot Knafeh
description: A unique dessert that combines the flaky pastry of knafeh with the earthy flavor of bamboo shoots, all from the Middle East.

ingredients.name: Knafeh Dough
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Cook knafeh dough according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sliced bamboo shoots over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Combine cottage cheese and confectioners' sugar in a bowl.
Add rose water to the cottage cheese mixture and stir well.
To assemble the knafeh, place a layer of cooked dough in the bottom of a serving dish.
Spread half of the cottage cheese mixture on top of the dough.
Add the heated bamboo shoots on top of the cottage cheese.
Spread the remaining cottage cheese mixture over the bamboo shoots.
Top with another layer of cooked dough.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped pistachios and serve.
